name: GALLEX
summary: GALLEX measured low-energy solar electron neutrinos with a gallium-chloride target. Its sensitivity to pp neutrinos extended the solar-neutrino programme below the chlorine-experiment threshold and helped establish the low-energy neutrino deficit.
detection_principle: Solar electron neutrinos transform gallium-71 into germanium-71. Chemical gas extraction isolates the few produced germanium atoms, whose decays are counted in low-background proportional counters. Chromium source calibrations test the full detection chain.
